== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34790) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds SOlson LS  Obi-Muning.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>17ef45daab5c7b4c08d786f4fcd1cf50c26124249efaaa27e89bc0fe6e2b9411</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
